sections.text:
-Ability Power 240. Damages all enemies 2 times with time-elemental magic damage at success of 100 points.
-Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Removes buffs from all enemies.
-Increases ATK/MATK of all allies by 40% for 60 seconds.
-Heals all allies for 5% of their max HP every 5 seconds for 60 seconds.
